#!/bin/bash
# AMP cluster wrapper: ClusterServer plus one ShardsServer per <Region> in ClusterConfig.xml.
# A region that dies makes the cluster panic and exit, so the whole set ends together and AMP restarts it.
cd "$(dirname "$0")" || exit 1
srv=../3976640/server
mapfile -t regions < <(sed 's/<!--.*-->//g' ClusterConfig.xml | grep -o '<Region [^>]*' | grep -o ' Address="[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f2)
rm -f amp-stop.flag tmp/luaexec/amp-stop.request
"$srv/ClusterServer" & cluster=$!
sleep 3
for r in "${regions[@]}"; do "$srv/ShardsServer" "$r" & done
stopping=0
while kill -0 "$cluster" 2>/dev/null; do
    if [ "$stopping" = 0 ] && [ -f amp-stop.flag ]; then
        stopping=1
        rm -f amp-stop.flag
        mkdir -p tmp/luaexec
        echo 'ShutdownServer()' > tmp/amp-stop.lua
        echo '{"requestId":"amp-stop","luaFilePath":"tmp/amp-stop.lua"}' > tmp/luaexec/amp-stop.request
        echo '[AMP] Stop requested, saving cluster'
    fi
    sleep 1
done
for _ in $(seq 60); do [ -z "$(jobs -pr)" ] && break; sleep 1; done
kill $(jobs -pr) 2>/dev/null
wait
